limitations: OOD domains (cnn, dialogsum, imdb, pubmed) are disjoint from the 10 in-domain domains.
The paraphrase set labels machine-paraphrased human text as AI (machine-touched).
Generator tag 'gpt-3.5-trubo' is the upstream spelling (sic).
Near-duplicate clusters are approximate (MinHash-LSH, Jaccard ~0.42 threshold).

source.download_instructions: Run `python -m bench.fetch_mage`. The script downloads the five MAGE CSVs from Hugging Face dataset yaful/MAGE at pinned revision 342663f0a2b7, inverts labels to the project convention, applies documented hygiene filters, builds a near-duplicate leakage-control index, and stores clean parquets under datasets/local/mage/ (gitignored). Raw text is never committed.
